gw_subfetch.big: The subscription is over {kb} KB — that’s not a list of keys.
gw_subfetch.cert_bad: Couldn’t verify the subscription server’s certificate (expired, self-signed or issued for another name) — keys not downloaded.
gw_subfetch.cert_changed: The subscription server’s certificate changed (was {old}…, now {new}…) — keys not updated. If the server was reinstalled, delete the subscription and add it again.
gw_subfetch.cert_domain: The certificate is issued for the domain {domain} — add the subscription by the domain or over http.
gw_subfetch.cert_other: The subscription server’s certificate isn’t issued for this address — add the subscription by the domain in the certificate or over http.
gw_subfetch.gone: The subscription server answered 404: there’s no subscription at this address (revoked or reissued).
gw_subfetch.internal: The subscription link points to an internal address ({addr}): such links aren’t downloaded — paste the subscription’s keys instead.
gw_subfetch.no_host: The subscription link has no server address.
gw_subfetch.paste.big: The subscription is over {kb} KB — paste the keys in parts.
gw_subfetch.paste.cert: Couldn’t verify the subscription server’s certificate ({err}) — paste the subscription’s contents instead.
gw_subfetch.paste.failed: Couldn’t download the subscription ({err}) — paste its contents instead.
gw_subfetch.paste.status: The subscription server answered {status} — paste the subscription’s contents instead.
gw_subfetch.redirects: Too many redirects for the subscription link (over {n}).
gw_subfetch.refused: The subscription server refuses connections (port closed).
gw_subfetch.scheme: Subscriptions only by an http:// or https:// link.
gw_subfetch.timeout: The subscription server didn’t answer within {s} s.
gw_subfetch.userinfo: Subscription links with a login and password in the address (user:pass@…) aren’t downloaded — paste the keys instead.
